seller_feedback.feedback_text: Great seller. Good communication  fast shipping and well packed.   Item as described
Excellent seller. Fast shipping and well packaged. The product is exactly as described. Good communication. 100% recommended. 5 stars!

This is the second set of rails I've ordered from this seller. They came well packaged, and exactly as described. They are a great value compared to new and show only slight signs of usage. They look almost like new. I was able to unpack and install these rails in minutes and the server slid right into its home in the rack! If you're looking for a quality seller you can trust.  Choose this one!  5/5 stars - would definitely recommend.

I order two sets of server rails from these guys.

One set arrived in perfect condition exactly as described.  The other arrived broken.

I wrote them for a return and within an hour they replied and got me taken care of.

I could not be any happier with how they took care of me, or with the quality of the functional rail set I got.

10/10 on all counts.

This server was exactly what I was looking for.  It was packaged well for shipping and arrived in fantastic condition.  The price was right especially now that computer prices are high.  There was a delay in shipping, but the seller was great to work with and found out it was an issue with FedEx.  Great seller to work with, and great selection of computer components.
Great seller, repeat buyer. Rack kit was perfect, exactly the right one for my server. Well-packed and priced, and delivered quickly. Will from them buy again.
Seller has been solid. Items are as described and arrive quickly. Quality = good. Condition = as described. Value = not bad. Appearance = used, so as expected. I will buy other items from this seller

This was a great sale...i only wish i had paid more attention because i ordered the wrong set of rails...and i was not going to ask the seller to pay for my mistake.  I will say this about the rails though, they are clean, they were packed with care, communication, turn around, shipping...couldn't have asked for more.  A++++ and thank you!!!
